column3: The season is called the return of the year; going out to war is not explicitly stated with the kings.
David actively finds the weight; the precious stone is singular.
The Hebrew says he sawed the people with a saw, iron cutting tools, and saws. It calls those returning with David all the people, not explicitly troops.
The shaft is called the wood of his spear.
The Hebrew says he was born to Rapha.
The Hebrew says these were born to Rapha and repeats “by the hand”.
